name: AGC 210220 (Hubble)
blurb: AGC 210220, an amorphous irregular dwarf galaxy, seen by Hubble.
label: agc210220-hubble
story: This faint, shapeless little galaxy is one of a dozen low-mass neighbors Hubble studied star by star, using its brightest red giants to measure its distance and test how the smallest galaxies hold on to their gas and stars.

claims.text: AGC 210220 is an amorphous irregular galaxy
Program 17480 studies twelve more nearby low-mass Local Volume galaxies
Distances come from the tip of the red giant branch in resolved stars
The program tests whether low-mass galaxies fail to accrete and retain baryons
